'''The Great Tree''' is a inn in the capital city of [[Cairhien]]. It is located in the older parts of the city and is frequented by wealthier peoples of higher class than that of the Foregate. It is run by Mistress [[Tiedra]]. [[Verin]] Sedai frequents the inn when she is in Cairhien and brings [[Rand]], [[Mat]], [[Perrin]], [[Loial]], [[Hurin]] and Lord [[Ingtar]] to the inn after the [[Horn of Valere]] is stolen.{{ref/book|2|31}}
